feedback: Reviewed before racing, so no outcome is stated for this candidate. It is the iteration 8 best design (score 686.6: sensors at y 0.06, kp 1.5, ki 0.02, base_speed 1.2, line_loss last_direction) with one change, controller.kd 0.6 to 0.7. Every field is within the contract ranges. The iteration 9 test of base_speed 1.4 scored 639.2, below the best. Its s-bend finishes fell to 17 of 20 and its oval time gain did not repay the lost finishes, so speed stays at 1.2 and this candidate does not change it. Damping has helped across the raced history: kd 0.3 to 0.5 cut oval line loss from 1.1 to 0.55 (iteration 3), and kd 0.5 to 0.6 raised slalom progress from 0.24 to 0.33 (iterations 5 to 6). Slalom has not finished in any race, so its gain is in progress only, and the score on the held-back tracks depends mainly on oval and s-bend finishes (about 950 points each). The risk is that the s-bend oscillation rises past the 0.4 guard. In iteration 6 it was 0.397 at y 0.04 and kd 0.6, and it fell to 0.314 when the sensors moved to y 0.06 (iteration 8). The kd 0.7 step is one value on the best design, so the result will be attributable. Read the next race as follows. If oval and s-bend both finish 20 of 20 (or hold at 18 or more) with steering_oscillation at or below 0.4, and slalom progress rises above 0.40, keep kd 0.7 as the new best. If any s-bend or oval finish is lost, or oscillation exceeds 0.4 on either track, revert kd to 0.6, which reproduces iteration 8's 686.6 result.
requested_changes: If oval and s-bend finishes hold (20 of 20, or at least 18 of 20) with steering_oscillation at or below 0.4 and slalom progress above 0.40, keep controller.kd at 0.7 and keep sensors at y 0.06 with base_speed 1.2; iteration 8 showed these fields give the best score (686.6), so the next change should be small.

If any oval or s-bend finish is lost or steering_oscillation exceeds 0.4 on either track, revert controller.kd to 0.6, since iteration 8 gave 20 of 20 finishes on both tracks at kd 0.6 and iteration 6 showed s-bend oscillation at 0.397 at y 0.04.

If slalom progress falls below 0.40 while finishes hold, kd 0.6 is the better choice; do not change base_speed again, because iteration 9 (base_speed 1.4) cost s-bend finishes (17 of 20) and scored 639.2.
